resources.string: Dropbox and Google Drive sign in when their public client IDs are supplied at build time. Until then those buttons use bundled sample files. OneDrive is coming soon. Google Photos stays on sample files. Nothing is uploaded in sample mode.
Space that can move to trash
Connect a sample account, then scan. Duplicate groups will show here as a preview grid.
Connect Dropbox or Google Drive, then scan. OneDrive is coming soon.
No duplicate groups in the connected accounts.
You are offline. Sample mode still works. Live sign-in needs a network connection.
These files will be moved to the provider trash or recycle bin. They will not be permanently deleted. Google Photos items are not included.
The sign-in session did not match. Connect again.
Sign-in did not finish. Connect again.
Allow moving files to trash in the sign-in screen. The move continues after you approve it.
Trash permission was not granted. Nothing was moved.
Sign-in finished. Scan again, then confirm the move to trash.
Could not list %1$s. The other accounts are still shown.
The provider did not move that file to trash.
Secure storage is unavailable. Demo tokens stay in memory for this session only.
%1$d files · %2$d groups. Open a group, keep one copy, then confirm.
Added to Duplicate review. The album does not delete anything.
Leave at least one copy in the group.
